notes.title: Twisted Logic: Abbotsfield - Out Now!
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to announce the release of our latest game "Twisted Logic: Abbotsfield" - a first-person psychological horror game with a twist!

One or more players must team up to unravel cryptic logic-based case files as you explore a haunted house to exorcise the demonic force haunting you.

Oh, and you only have one hour to do it.

Check it out below!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3261060/Twisted_Logic_Abbotsfield/

notes.title: Announcing Rockets Are Super Hard: Relaunch
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to announce the release of ROCKETS ARE SUPER HARD: RELAUNCH - a free major update that remasters our punishingly difficult local co-op party indie game!

Out now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/675270/Rockets_Are_Super_Hard

Here’s what’s new:

🎨 A complete visual overhaul of the entire game end to end. Launch those rockets in style with a higher, shinier fidelity!

🚀 We’ve polished and consolidated our core campaign into 20 missions spanning a range of difficulties.

📝 A new tutorial video to help get your party started.

🎶 Epic remastered music. Soundtrack that stress.

🔊 Brand new sound effects and voiceover.

We hope you enjoy!
